title: Kissed Fluffy Spanish Beans Stew
description: A comforting nutty bean stew with sweet peppers, pickles, and a creamy cheese finish, perfect for a sick day comfort meal.
instructions: Soak the navy beans overnight in a large pot of water.
Drain and rinse the beans and set aside.
Heat the olive oil in a large pot over medium heat and sauté the onion until translucent.
Add the minced garlic and diced bell pepper and cook for another 3 minutes.
Stir in the smoked paprika and ground cumin and cook for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add the soaked beans, pickled green beans, and vegetable broth and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 60 minutes, or until beans are tender.
Uncover, stir in the crumbled feta cheese and toasted almonds, and season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot and enjoy the nutty, fluffy texture of this comforting Spanish bean stew.
